title: Manage Asset Requirements
acceptance_criteria: 1.1.1 Requestor (Asset_SAF) shall be able to create, update, view, verify, reject and delete CR asset requirements.
1.1.2 Requirements shall be submitted at ReqCen level (select from drop down list).
1.1.3 Requirements shall be based on CR Type (select from drop down list), CR category (select from drop down list), and quantities in whole number.
1.1.4 Each requirement shall indicate the requesting unit (free text), EE (select from drop down list of EGBs and Essential Companies).
1.1.5 System shall have a field to select the approving authority (select from drop down list).
1.1.6 System shall have a free text field to enter internal remarks, e.g. approval reference and approval date.
1.1.7 Requestor (Asset_SAF) shall be able to view current and rejected CR asset requirements.
1.1.8 System shall have a function to download a template containing all the essential fields that shall be populated to support mass load into CRIPS.
1.1.9 System shall have a function to upload a filled template containing all the information needed to mass upload the CR asset requirements into CRIPS.
1.1.10 System shall restrict Requestor (Asset_SAF) from entering requirements for the same CR type, CR category, Requesting Unit/EE under multiple ReqCens.
1.1.11 Requestor (Asset_SAF) shall be able to view the allocation by CR category, including substitution CR category and the corresponding quantity allocated.
1.1.12 Requestor (Asset_SAF) shall be able to export/download the information.

1.1.13 Requestor (Asset_SAF) shall be able to search using keywords. On the screen, he/she shall be able to fill out the search field and fields allowable for search shall have text hint of the search field.

title: Manage Asset Exemption
acceptance_criteria: 1.2.1 Requestor (Asset_SAF) shall be able to create, update, view and delete CR asset exemption request.
1.2.2 Asset exemption requests shall be routed to the respective Controller for approval. Controller can approve or reject the request.

1.2.3 Requestor (Asset_SAF) shall be able to create requests to un-exempt assets that the Controllers have approved earlier. Such requests shall be routed to the respective Controller for approval. He/She shall be able to update, view and delete such requests.

1.2.4 Exempted assets cannot be allocated nor requisitioned. When EMA_AO or EMA_EO attempt to requisition an exempted asset, system shall prompt appropriate message to inform him/her the asset is exempted from requisition.
1.2.5 Requestor (Asset_SAF) shall be able to export/download the information.

1.2.6 Requestor (Asset_SAF) shall be able to search using keywords. On the screen, he/she shall be able to fill out the search field and fields allowable for search shall have text hint of the search field.

title: Manage Annual Exercise Plan
acceptance_criteria: 1.3.1 Requestor (Asset_SAF) shall be able to view the information for the ReqCens that he/she is authorised.
1.3.2 System shall display a summary of the ReqCens, the ReqCen Description, Previous and Last Exercise Dates and the Planned Exercise Workyear (e.g. WY 2025).
1.3.3 The Previous and Last CR Exercise Dates shall be updated automatically after ReqCen has completed their CR exercise.

1.3.4 System shall derive the Planned Exercise Workyear for each ReqCen taking reference from its last exercise dates. A mapping table shall be set-up to define the mapping logic for Planned Exercise Workyear. For example, the planned exercise workyear for ReqCen A is +3 years from its last exercise date.
1.3.5 System shall show the most current Planned Exercise Workyear if this information is updated by the respective Controller.

1.3.6 Upon clicking onto the respective ReqCen’s previous or last CR exercise date, system shall display the exercise scale, i.e. the number of CR owners and the number of CR assets participated in that exercise.

acceptance_criteria: 2.3.1 CRO(Asset) shall be able to view the information for the ReqCens that he/she is authorised.
2.3.2 System shall display a summary of the ReqCens, the ReqCen Description, Previous and Last Exercise Dates and the Planned Exercise Workyear (e.g. WY 2025).

title: Manage Requisition Plan
acceptance_criteria: 2.4.1 CRO(Asset) shall be able to create, update, view and delete Requisition Plan for the ReqCens that he/she is authorised.
2.4.2 CRO(Asset) shall be able to export/download the details of Requisition Plans.
2.4.3 System shall restrict each CR requisition plan to have only one ReqCen and there must be a start and end date for every plan.
2.4.4 Have various plan types and user must select ‘Training’, ‘Exercise’ or ‘Operations’ when creating a CR requisition plan.

2.4.5 In planning the participating list of CR categories, all CR categories managed by the ReqCen shall be listed and CRO(Asset) shall select the CR categories to be included in the Requisition Plan.

2.4.6 In planning the participating list of CR owners, recommendations shall be provided to CRO(Asset) on which CR owners should be earmarked for mobilisation exercise, e.g. a. Display the last mobilisation date for each CR owner.
2.4.7 RFQ No. DEFNGPP7126100138 b. Indicate whether the CR owner is due for exercise.

2.4.8 In the Requisition Plan, display the CR owner, CR categories, CR requirement (i.e. required quantity) and CR allocated quantity, then a. Allow CRO(Asset) to input quantity, i.e. the quantity to requisition. System shall ensure the quantity cannot exceed the CR allocated quantity. b. Allow CRO(Asset) to select/earmark specific asset to requisition, e.g. vehicle registration number XD2103T.
2.4.9 In the Requisition Plan, CRO(Asset) shall be able to select the planned CR categories and planned CR quantity to be distributed to the Requesting Unit/EE.

2.4.10 For each CR category, the planned CR quantity can exceed the quantity demanded by the Requesting Unit/Essential Establishment (EE) but it must not exceed the earmarked quantity listed in the Requisition Plan.

2.4.11 At the Requisition Plan summary page, CRO(Asset) shall be able to view the total number of CR owners, the total number of CR categories, the total CR quantities included in the plan. It shall also provide the required budget to support the Requisition Plan, e.g. a. Estimated cost for 4-hours for each CR category. b. Estimated cost for 1-day w/o undertaking for each category. c. Estimated cost for 1 day with undertaking for each category. d. Estimated cost for 4-hours for the entire Requisition Plan. e. Estimated cost for 1-day w/o undertaking for the entire Requisition Plan. f. Estimated cost for 1 day with undertaking for the entire Requisition Plan.
2.4.12 CRO(Asset) shall be able to save the draft Requisition Plan.
2.4.13 CRO(Asset) shall be able to amend or delete the draft Requisition Plan.
2.4.14 Once the CRO(Asset) is satisfied with the draft Requisition Plan, he/she shall submit the plan and it shall be routed to Chief Controller Office for approval.
2.4.15 Incomplete Requisition Plan cannot be submitted. Chief Controller Office shall either approve or reject the Requisition Plan.

2.4.16 Upon committing an Exercise or Operations Requisition Plan, system shall auto generate and send emails, informing the CR Owners that they have been selected to participate in an upcoming CR requisition. The email shall contain pertinent details such as the period that they could be activated, the CR assets and quantity required for requisition, the primary and alternate/secondary EMA address, and contact details of the CRO(Asset), name and appointment of the Competent Authority.
2.4.17 System shall provide relevant warning and/or error messages that are self- explanatory to guide CRO(Asset).
2.4.18 CRO(Asset) shall be able to search using keywords. On the screen, he/she shall be able to fill out the search field and fields allowable for search shall have text hint of the search field.

acceptance_criteria: 2.8.1 The CR Owners shall be segregated into “Allocated CR Owners” and “Unallocated CR Owners”. a. Allocated CR Owners. They can be allocated to one or more ReqCens. They are generally termed as shared CR Owner if the company is supporting more than one ReqCen. CRO(Asset) shall be only be able to access records based on the ReqCen he/she is assigned to. CRO(Asset) shall be able to view when

2.8.2 RFQ No. DEFNGPP7126100138 the CR Owner was last mobilised. For shared CR Owner, the last mobilisation date for each ReqCen shall be shown. b. Unallocated CR Owners. CRO(Asset) shall be able to view the record so that they have the relevant information to reach out to CR Owners who may have suitable heavy plants to meet the ReqCen’s needs.

2.8.3 System shall include the following in the header information: UEN number, Company Name, Status of the company, Mailing Address, Office/Site Address, GST Registration Number, Office Contact Number, Other Contact Number (e.g.
2.8.4 Mobile Number), Email Address etc. Some of these information shall be retrieved from the ACRA interface file while some information, e.g. email address shall be editable by CRO(Asset).
2.8.5 System shall include the following for ReqCen-level information: CR Owner’s POC names, their mobile number, office number, fax number and email address.

2.8.6 CRO(Asset) shall be able to include multiple POC numbers. CRO(Asset) shall also be able to select the primary POC and secondary POC who will receive our SMS notifications broadcast from official MINDEF/SAF or WOG communication channel, e.g. sender ID “gov.sg”.

2.8.7 CRO(Asset) shall be able to view the CR Owners’ assets which shall be grouped and presented logically. a. “CR Assets Owned” shall show each CR category and their respective Quantity. It shall provide the total number of CR assets of the CR Owner. b. “CR Category Allocated to ReqCens” shall show the CR category, Quantity Allocated and ReqCen Allocated. It shall provide the allocation to ownership ratio. E.g. if a CR Owner owns 10 assets and only 5 are allocated, the allocation ratio is 50%. c. “ReqCen Allocation History” shall show the Allocation Date and the corresponding ReqCen. It shall provide a summary of the total allocation records. d. “De-allocation History” shall show the De-allocation Date and the corresponding ReqCen and Reason for De-allocation.

2.8.10 CRO(Asset) shall be able to view all the CR assets of the CR Owners. Information shall include CR Type, CR Category, Registration Number, Chassis Number, Engine Number, etc.

title: Activation
acceptance_criteria: 4.1.1 EMA_HQ shall be able to enter the activation date and time, select ‘Primary EMA’ or ‘Alternate/Secondary EMA’.
4.1.2 EMA_HQ shall be able to amend the activation date and time if the original date/time has not lapsed.
4.1.3 For Training Plan, EMA_HQ shall be able to enter up to 2 mobile numbers to receive the activation message.

4.1.4 Upon clicking on ‘Activate’ button and on the activation date and time, a. Notifications shall be sent via SMSes to CR Owner’s POCs. The contents in the SMSes may be generic or specific, and shall allow customisation/configuration easily. The SMS contents may vary according to ReqCens and EMA. Ability to use WOG products such as ‘Postman’ shall be explored. b. Notices/Orders shall be published in CR Owner Portal. CR Owners shall login to the CR Owner Portal to retrieve the notices/orders to find out more information of the activation and to acknowledge the notices/orders.
4.1.5 EMA_HQ shall be able to toggle between primary and alternate/secondary EMA and then re-activate the requisition plan.

4.1.6 Upon clicking on ‘Activate’ button following changes to EMA selection, a. Notifications shall be sent via SMSes to CR Owner’s POCs. The contents in the SMSes may be generic or specific, and shall allow customisation/configuration easily. The SMS contents may vary according to ReqCens and EMA. Ability to use WOG products such as ‘Postman’ shall be explored. b. New notices/orders shall be published in CR Owner Portal. CR Owners shall login to the CR Owner Portal to retrieve the new notices/orders to find out more information of the re-activation and to acknowledge the new notices/orders.

4.1.7 System shall track and display the user who last activated/re-activated the plan. It shall display the name of this user, and the date/time of the last activation/re- activation made by him/her.

title: Status Tracking
acceptance_criteria: 4.2.1 System shall display UEN number, Company Name, Acknowledgement and Reporting Status, CR Owner Response Time, Primary and Secondary POC name and their respective contact number.

4.2.2 CR Owners who have acknowledged the activation message, system shall display the status as ‘Acknowledged’ and include the acknowledgement phone number, date and time. Otherwise, status shall be displayed as ‘Not Yet Acknowledged’.

4.2.3 System shall display the requisition status as ‘Reported’ and include the reporting date and time after the CR Owners’ assets are requisitioned. If CR Owner is earmarked to report with multiple assets, the status should only be displayed as ‘Reported’ when all the earmarked assets are requisitioned. Status shall be displayed as ‘Partial Assets Report’ if partial quantities are requisitioned. Otherwise, status shall be displayed as ‘Not Yet Reported’.

4.2.4 System shall display the CR Owner response time. If CR Owner is earmarked to report with multiple assets, the response time shall be computed using the last asset requisitioned date/time versus the activation start date/time.
4.2.5 EMA_HQ shall be able to filter by different status.
4.2.6 EMA_HQ shall be able to search using keywords. On the screen, he/she shall be able to fill out the search field and fields allowable for search shall have text hint of the search field.

title: Perform Requisition and Derequisition
acceptance_criteria: 5.1.1 EMA_AO and EMA_EO shall be able to use their personal device to access CRIPS EMA Web and sign-in using his/her Singpass.
5.1.2 EMA_AO and EMA_EO shall be able to display, update, delete requisition plan listings.
5.1.3 EMA_AO and EMA_EO shall be able to create and display registration information of the asset.
5.1.4 EMA_AO and EMA_EO shall be able to update and display inspection checklist.
5.1.5 EMA_AO shall be able to update and display the requisition details.
5.1.6 EMA_AO and EMA_EO shall be able to update and display issue and return details.
5.1.7 EMA_AO shall be able to update and read the derequisition details.
5.1.8 EMA_AO and EMA_EO shall be able to create and display contingency and register new asset.

title: Requisition Plan Listing
acceptance_criteria: 5.2.1 EMA_AO and EMA_EO shall be able to use their personal device to access CRIPS EMA Web and sign-in using his/her Singpass.
5.2.2 EMA_AO and EMA_EO shall be able to search the list of assets belonging to CR Owners earmarked to participate in the ‘Training’, ‘Exercise’ or ‘Operation’ plan.
5.2.3 EMA_AO and EMA_EO shall be able to do advance filter such as searching by CR category or earmarked CR asset number.

5.2.4 EMA_AO and EMA_EO shall be able to search specific assets (e.g. by the asset registration number) from a master list of assets maintained in CRIPS. The results should provide information such as the CR Owner, CR category that would be useful to EMA_AO and EMA_EO.

title: Registration
acceptance_criteria: 5.3.1 EMA_AO and EMA_EO shall be able to use their personal device to access CRIPS EMA Web and sign-in using his/her Singpass.

5.3.2 Within the Registration module, EMA_AO and EMA_EO shall be able to use the Optical Character Recognition (OCR) or other suitable technology to scan the asset registration number and validate whether the asset belongs to any of the CR Owners earmarked in the requisition plan. EMA_AO and EMA_EO shall also be able to key in the asset registration number manually in the Registration module.

5.3.3 System shall disallow EMA_AO and EMA_EO to register the asset if the asset is exempted/under immunity from requisition. Appropriate error message shall be prompted to inform him/her of the reason.

5.3.4 system shall disallow EMA_AO and EMA_EO to register the asset, if the asset does not belong to any of the CR Owners earmarked in the requisition plan. Appropriate error message shall be prompted to inform him/her of the reason.

5.3.5 EMA_AO and EMA_EO shall be prompted of the mismatch or discrepancy, if the asset belongs to one of the CR Owners earmarked in the requisition plan but the asset is not within the earmarked CR category,. He/she shall be allowed to register new asset (for ‘Training’ and ‘Operation’ requisition plan only) and manage it as a OFFICIAL (CLOSED) OFFICIAL (CLOSED)

5.3.6 substitution by choosing from the list of earmarked CR category. Alternatively, he/she can reject the asset, i.e. do not register as new CR asset in CRIPS. To complete the Registration process, a. System shall require EMA_AO or EMA_EO to enter the name, NRIC number/FIN, contact number of the CR Owner or his representative who brought in the asset for registration. b. The registration date/time shall be defaulted to current date/time. EMA_AO and EMA_EO shall be allowed to amend the registration date/time. Controls shall be in place to ensure it is not later than the current date/time. c. System shall support the use of OCR or other suitable technology to scan the information on the NRIC, including digital NRIC.

title: Inspection
acceptance_criteria: 5.4.1 EMA_AO and EMA_EO shall be able to use their personal device to access CRIPS EMA Web and sign-in using his/her Singpass.
5.4.2 System shall ensure that only assets that have been registered successfully in the Registration stage can proceed to the Inspection stage.
5.4.3 System shall generate the checklist in accordance with the CR type of the asset. There shall be unique checklist for (i) CR Vessels, (ii) CR Craft; (iii) CR Vehicles, and (iv) CR Heavy Plants.

5.4.4 Upon the completion of physical inspection of the asset, EMA_AO and EMA_EO shall update the inspection results in the system. a. EMA_AO and EMA_EO shall be able to select ‘Pass’, ‘Fail’ or ‘N.A.’ for each inspection category as well as the detailed checklist within each inspection category. b. EMA_AO and EMA_EO shall be able to choose ‘Pass’ or ‘Fail’ the inspection of the asset. System shall allow only assets that have passed inspection to proceed to the Requisition stage. Those that failed inspection shall be rejected and disallowed from requisition. c. If the asset is rejected, system shall prompt him/her the reason(s) for rejection. An email notification shall be triggered to inform the CR owner that his/her vehicle is rejected and the reason.
5.4.5 EMA_AO and EMA_EO shall be able to take photos of the vehicles and upload to the system.

5.4.6 To complete the Inspection process, a. System shall require EMA_AO or EMA_EO to enter the name, NRIC number/FIN, contact number of the CR Owner or his representative who OFFICIAL (CLOSED) OFFICIAL (CLOSED) b. c. RFQ No. DEFNGPP7126100138 present the asset for requisition. System shall default this information based on the same details collected at the Registration stage. System shall still allow EMA_AO and EMA_EO to update the information. The inspection date/time shall be defaulted to current date/time. EMA_AO and EMA_EO shall be allowed to amend the inspection date/time. Controls shall be in place to ensure it is not later than the current date/time, as well as not earlier than the registration date/time. System shall support the use of OCR or other suitable technology to scan the information on the NRIC, including digital NRIC.

title: Requisition
acceptance_criteria: 5.5.1 System shall restrict the requisition function to EMA_AO only.
5.5.2 EMA_AO shall be able to use their personal device to access CRIPS EMA Web and sign-in using his/her Singpass.

5.5.3 System shall ensure that for exercise and training requisition plans, only assets that have passed inspection can be requisitioned. For ‘Operation’ requisition plans, the Inspection stage can be skipped/by-passed.

5.5.4 To complete the Requisition process, a. EMA_AO shall be able to use OCR or other suitable technology to scan the asset registration number and validate whether the asset belongs to any of the CR Owners earmarked in the requisition plan. EMA_AO shall also be allowed to key in the asset registration number manually in the Requisition module. b. c. When there is a mismatch between the earmarked CR category and the CR category of the reported asset, system shall prompt accordingly and also allow EMA_AO to select the CR category it would be substituting. System shall auto-fill all the information related to the asset, the requisition date/time, estimated compensation amount, GST amount, etc onto the Requisition form.  The requisition date/time shall be defaulted to current date/time. EMA_AO shall be allowed to amend the requisition date/time. Controls shall be in place to ensure it is not later than the current date/time, as well as not earlier than the inspection date/time. If Inspection is ‘by- pass’, the requisition date/time cannot be earlier than the registration date/time.  The compensation amount shall be derived based on minimally 4-hour requisition duration using ‘with undertaking’ hourly rate. If substitution CR category is accepted at the Requisition stage, the compensation amount shall be derived using the lower rate. OFFICIAL (CLOSED) OFFICIAL (CLOSED) d. e. f. g. RFQ No. DEFNGPP7126100138 System shall require EMA_AO to enter the name, NRIC number/FIN, contact number of the CR Owner or his representative who present the asset for requisition. System shall default this information based on the same details collected earlier (i.e. Registration and Inspection stages) and still allow EMA_AO to update the information. System shall support the use of OCR or other suitable technology to scan the information on the NRIC, including digital NRIC. System shall require EMA_AO to choose the EMA that received the requisitioned asset, i.e. Primary EMA or Alternate/Secondary EMA. EMA_AO shall be able to e-sign on the digital requisition form. Ability to digital-sign the requisition form via WOG products such as Signify shall be explored.  System shall auto generate the requisition form and send it to the CR owner via email. The requisition forms shall be password protected and shall also be made available in the CR Owner Portal for them to retrieve the receipts/forms.

title: De-Requisition (applicable for EMA_AO only)
acceptance_criteria: 5.6.1 System shall restrict the de-requisition function to EMA_AO only.
5.6.2 EMA_AO shall be able to use their personal device to access CRIPS EMA Web and sign-in using his/her Singpass.

5.6.3 System shall ensure that only assets held at the ReqCen level can be de- requisitioned. For assets that have been issued/distributed to Unit/EEs/DIV and not returned to ReqCen, system shall not allow EMA_AO to perform the de-requisition function.

5.6.4 To complete the De-Requisition process, a. EMA_AO shall be able to use OCR or other suitable technology to scan the asset registration number and validate whether the asset has been returned to the ReqCen. EMA_AO shall also be allowed to key in the asset registration number manually in the De-Requisition module. b. System shall auto-fill all the information related to the asset, the requisition and de-requisition date/time, compensation amount, GST amount onto the De-Requisition form.  The de-requisition date/time shall be defaulted to current date/time.

title: Issue-To
acceptance_criteria: 5.7.1 EMA_AO and EMA_EO shall be able to use their personal device to access CRIPS EMA Web and sign-in using his/her Singpass.
5.7.2 EMA_AO and EMA_EO shall be able to issue requisitioned assets to the requesting unit/EE (select from drop down list) and the unit representative (enter a valid NRIC number/FIN).
5.7.3 EMA_AO and EMA_EO shall be able to select individual or multiple assets to perform the Issue-to-Unit/EE transaction.
5.7.4 EMA_AO and EMA_EO shall be able to issue units/EEs with number of assets exceeding the requesting Units/EEs’ allocated quantity.

5.7.5 System shall be able to handle multiple tiers of asset redistribution and have a two- step transfer function to support this. a. Issue/Distribute to DIV. EMA_AO and EMA_EO shall be able to issue/distribute to DIV. The issuing ReqCen, EMA_AO/EO’s NRIC number, receiving Unit and the EMA_DIV_RP’s NRIC number shall be included in the issuing and receiving transaction. System shall auto-create account for EMA_DIV_RP based on the NRIC number stated in the issue transaction.

5.7.6 b. Issue/Distribute to BDE. EMA_DIV_RP shall be able to issue to the next echelon, i.e. BDE. The issuing DIV, EMA_DIV_RP’s NRIC number, receiving Unit and the EMA_BDE_RP’s NRIC number shall be included in the issuing and receiving transaction. System shall auto-create account for EMA_BDE_RP based on the NRIC number stated in the issue transaction.

5.7.7 He/She shall be able to use his/her personal device to access CRIPS EMA web and sign-in using his/her Singpass. EMA_BDE_RP shall be required to accept the transferred assets. c. Issue/Distribute to BN. EMA_BDE_RP shall be able to issue to the next echelon, i.e. BN. The issuing BDE, EMA_BDE_RP’s NRIC number, receiving Unit and the EMA_BN_RP’s NRIC number shall be included in the issuing and receiving transaction. System shall auto-create account for EMA_BN_RP based on the NRIC number stated in the issue transaction.

5.7.8 He/She shall be able to use his/her personal device to access CRIPS EMA web and sign-in using his/her Singpass. EMA_BN_RP shall be required to accept the transferred assets. d. Issue/Distribute to Unit. EMA_AO and EMA_EO shall be able to issue/distribute to Unit. The issuing ReqCen, EMA_AO/EO’s NRIC number, receiving Unit and the EMA_UNIT_RP’s NRIC number shall be included in the issuing and receiving transaction. System shall auto-create account for EMA_UNIT_RP based on the NRIC number stated in the issue transaction.
5.7.9 He/She shall be able to use his/her personal device to access CRIPS EMA web and sign-in using his/her Singpass. EMA_UNIT_RP shall be required to accept the transferred assets.

title: Return-To-ReqCen
acceptance_criteria: 5.8.1 RFQ No. DEFNGPP7126100138 EMA_AO, EMA_EO, EMA_DIV_RP, EMA_BDE_RP, EMA_BN_RP and EMA_UNIT_RP shall be able to use their personal device to access CRIPS EMA Web and sign-in using his/her Singpass.
5.8.2 EMA_AO and EMA_EO shall be able to select assets that are issued to a particular unit/EE (select from drop down list) and the unit representative (enter a valid NRIC number/FIN).
5.8.3 EMA_AO and EMA_EO shall be able to select individual or multiple assets to perform Return-from-Unit/EE transaction.

5.8.4 System shall be able to handle return of assets that are redistributed and have a two- step transfer function to support this. a. Return from Unit to ReqCen. EMA_UNIT_RP shall be able to return the assets to the ReqCen directly. EMA_AO and EMA_EO shall be required to accept the returned assets. The returning Unit, EMA_UNIT_RP’s NRIC number, receiving ReqCen and the EMA_AO/EO’s NRIC number shall be included in the returning and receiving transaction. b. Return from BN to ReqCen. EMA_BN_RP shall be able to return the assets to the ReqCen directly. EMA_AO and EMA_EO shall be required to accept the returned assets. The returning BN, EMA_BN_RP’s NRIC number, receiving ReqCen and the EMA_AO/EO’s NRIC number shall be included in the returning and receiving transaction. c. Return from BDE to ReqCen. EMA_BDE_RP shall be able to return the assets to the ReqCen directly. EMA_AO and EMA_EO shall be required to accept the returned assets. The returning BDE, EMA_BDE_RP’s NRIC number, receiving ReqCen and the EMA_AO/EO’s NRIC number shall be included in the returning and receiving transaction. d. Return from DIV to ReqCen. EMA_DIV_RP shall be able to return the assets to the ReqCen directly. EMA_AO and EMA_EO shall be required to accept the returned assets. The returning DIV, EMA_DIV_RP’s NRIC number, receiving ReqCen and the EMA_AO/EO’s NRIC number shall be included in the returning and receiving transaction.

5.8.5 System shall be able to handle direct return from unit/EE to ReqCen via one-step transfer. The returning unit/EE, NRIC number of the unit representative who is returning the assets, receiving ReqCen and NRIC number of the EMA_AO or EMA_EO shall be included in the returning and acceptance transaction. The returning unit/EE representative is not required to login to CRIPS to return the assets.
5.8.6 System shall be able to track every asset and the individuals accountable for the asset at all times.
5.8.7 All returning and acceptance parties shall be able to e-sign the HOTO document.
5.8.8 Ability to digital-sign the HOTO forms via WOG products such as Signify shall be explored.

title: Register New Asset/Commandeering
acceptance_criteria: 5.9.1 EMA_AO, EMA_EO shall be able to use their personal device to access CRIPS EMA Web and sign-in using his/her Singpass.

5.9.2 Register new asset, a. System shall restrict this function to only Heavy Plant CR type. b. System shall restrict this function to only ‘Training’ and ‘Operation’ requisition plans. EMA_AO and EMA_EO shall not be allowed to register new assets for Exercise plans. c. For new assets introduced via ‘Training’ requisition plans, the asset shall not be included permanently as CR supplies data in CRIPS. d. For new assets introduced via ‘Operation’ requisition plans, the asset shall be included permanently as CR supplies data in CRIPS. Only Controller Vehicles Office can update/de-register the such assets.

5.9.3 Commandeering, a. b. System shall restrict this function to only EMA_AO. Upon clicking on ‘Commandeering’ function, EMA_AO shall be able to use OCR or other suitable technology to scan the asset registration number. EMA_AO shall also be able to key in the asset registration number manually. System shall auto fill other information such as CR category, chassis number, engine number that shall be retrieved from CRIPS database using the asset registration number. c. System shall require EMA_AO to enter the UEN/NRIC Number, Company Name/Owner Name, Company/Owner address and asset registration number. d. System shall support the use of OCR or other suitable technology to scan the information on the NRIC, including digital NRIC. e. The registration date/time shall be defaulted to current date/time. EMA_AO shall be allowed to amend the registration date/time. Controls shall be in place to ensure it is not later than the current date/time. f. The requisition workflow is the same as the earmarked assets.

acceptance_criteria: 5.10.1 RFQ No. DEFNGPP7126100138 EMA_AO, EMA_EO, EMA_DIV_RP, EMA_BDE_RP, EMA_BN_RP and EMA_UNIT_RP shall be able to use their personal device to access CRIPS EMA Web and sign-in using his/her Singpass.

Number of assets accepted refers to those assets transferred and accepted by EMA_BDE_RP via two -step transfer. b. Transfer Accepted by BN RP Summary. This summary information displays the number of accepted assets per category versus the number of assets transferred per category. It also shows the total number of accepted assets versus the total number of assets transferred. Number of assets accepted refers to those assets transferred and accepted by EMA_BN_RP via two -step transfer.

18.3.2 The system shall also track and update the status to ‘Acknowledged’. System shall log and display the timestamp of the acknowledgment.

18.3.3 System shall be able to mark the notifications as ‘Read’ once the CR owner view the message, i.e. even without clicking the ‘Acknowledge’ button, the status shall be updated to ‘Read’. System shall log and display the timestamp of when the notification was read.
18.3.4 CR owner shall be able to view and re-open past notifications even though they have been read and/or acknowledged.

18.3.5 System shall list the notifications according to the timestamp it was sent and display the most recent notifications on top of the list. New notifications that have not been read shall be have a ‘New’ icon to highlight/draw attention. System shall also show the total number of new notifications.

title: Resources Earmarked for Requisition
acceptance_criteria: 18.4.1 For ‘Exercise’ and ‘Operation’ Requisition Plans, system shall auto generate and send emails, informing the CR Owners that they have been selected to participate in an upcoming CR requisition.

18.4.2 CR owner shall be able to retrieve such notifications via the CR Owner Portal. He/She shall be able to view the pertinent details such as the period that they could be activated, the types of CR assets and quantity required for requisition, the primary and alternate EMA address, and contact details of the CROs, name and appointment of the Competent Authority. 18.4.3 CR Owner shall be able to use the appropriate functions in the CR Owner Portal to inform the CROs on the availability of the allocated CR assets when assets not serviceable.

18.4.4 CR Owner shall be able to use the appropriate functions in the CR Owner Portal to notify the CROs of changes in their heavy plant assets. For example, new heavy plants acquired and existing heavy plants that have been sold or disposed.

title: Receipts of Requisition and De-requisition
acceptance_criteria: 18.5.1 After the requisition of each CR asset, system shall auto send the receipt of requisition to CR owner via an email to inform him/her the completion of the asset requisition. He/She shall be able to retrieve the receipts of requisition via the CR Owner Portal.

18.5.2 After the derequisition of each CR asset, system shall auto send the receipt of de- requisition to CR owner via an email to inform him/her the completion of the asset de-requisition. He/She shall be able to retrieve the receipts of de-requisition via the CR Owner Portal.
18.5.3 CR Owner shall be able to view the pertinent details such as Requisition, Derequisition and Compensation amount.

18.5.4 CR Owner shall be able to select the receipts and notify the CRO on matters related to the CR requisition. Upon submitting, owner, system shall send emails to the CRO to inform him/her on the message(s) submitted by the CR owner.
18.5.5 CR Owners shall be able to enquire on compensation payment status.

title: Chatbot
acceptance_criteria: 18.6.1 System shall ensure that upon successful login to the CR Owner Portal, the Chatbot icon/button shall be visible and accessible at all times.
18.6.2 CR owners shall be able to type and submit questions.
18.6.3 System’s chatbot shall display only information that is assigned to that CR owner and not address queries that may provide information/ sensitive details about other CR owners.
18.6.4 System’s chatbot shall display restricted information and shall display appropriate access restriction message when CR owner attempt to ask or retrieve unauthorised data.
18.6.5 System’s chatbot shall be quick in responding (i.e. within a certain timeframe).
18.6.6 System’s chatbot shall provide a fallback response when it cannot understand or answer to a query.
18.6.7 System’s chatbot shall prompt the CR owner to provide or clarify if additional details are required.
18.6.8 In the event that the Chatbot service is unavailable, system shall display an appropriate message informing the CR owner that Chatbot assistance is temporarily unavailable.
18.6.9 System shall ensure that the chat history shall remain available during the CR owner’s active session.
18.6.10 System shall allow administrator to extract chat history for analysis.

title: System Administration for CR owner Portal
acceptance_criteria: 18.7.1 Administrator shall be able to publish information such as downtime message in the CR Owner Portal to inform CR owners of the upcoming system maintenance and downtime.
18.7.2 Administrator shall be able to publish forms that are useful for CR owners, e.g. the latest Application form for Interbank GIRO.
18.7.3 Administrator shall be able to view CR owner’s details uploaded in the CR owner portal.
18.7.4 Administrator shall be able to download all read and acknowledgement activities performed by CR owners.
18.7.5 Administrator shall be able to download the details of the CR owner’s assets. 19. ADMINISTRATOR USER STORY

title: Manage Users
acceptance_criteria: 19.1.1 Administrator shall not be allowed to manage his/her own account.

19.1.2 By default, system shall display the current list of “Active” users, with search function to search users by NRIC number, UserID or Name. There shall be advance filter function to search by appointment, role, email address, and also toggle to display the list “Inactive” users. Fields to be displayed include: NRIC number, UserID, Name, Roles Assigned, Appointment, Ministry/Agency, Unit/Department, Email Address, Date of Last Update. Sort function shall be included.

19.1.3 Administrator shall be able to create new user account. When creating new users, system shall require the Administrator to enter information such as NRIC number, UserID, Full Name, Appointment, Unit/Department, Ministry/Agency, Work email (internet), Role Assignment (main and sub-roles) etc. Certain fields shall require Administrator to select from pre-defined list, such as Ministry/Agency and ReqCens. Option fields shall include “Remarks”, etc. All logins shall be via SingPass and there shall be appropriate validation to check the NRIC number is valid. For MINDEF/SAF users, there shall be an additional layer to valid the NRIC number and UserID exist in EAD/EIMS. System shall log all activities that are related to creating new user account.

19.1.4 Administrator shall be able to add, change and remove the role assignment (main and sub-roles) of an existing user account. He/She shall be able to toggle “Active” and “Inactive” status of the users. For changing the role assignment of an exisiting user account, there shall be a pre-defined list of roles for the Administrator to choose from.
19.1.5 Administrator shall be able to delete an existing user account.
19.1.6 System shall provide an option for Administrator to export the list of users. He/She can select for the output file to be in Excel or PDF format.

title: Manage App Settings
acceptance_criteria: 19.2.1 Administrator shall be able to set the maximum upload file size. There shall be individual setting for Assets, Undertakings and Compensation modules.

19.2.2 Administrator shall be able to set the valid admin upload file extensions such as xls, xlsx, doc, docx, ppt, pptx, pdf, zip, png, jpg, jpeg. There shall be individual setting for Assets, Undertakings and Compensation modules.

19.2.3 Administrator shall be able to set the valid user upload file extensions such as xls, xlsx, doc, docx, ppt, pptx, pdf, zip, png, jpg, jpeg. There shall be individual setting for Assets, Undertakings and Compensation modules.
19.2.4 Administrator shall be able to create a generic error message to show to users if any database exception error happens.
19.2.5 Administrator shall be able to set the maximum number of records/lines to show to users on every list screen.

19.2.6 Administrator shall be able to generate system downtime notices for announcements in CRIPS as well as broadcast via sending auto emails to all CRIPS users. Administrator shall be able to select the mode of announcement/broadcast.

title: Acceptable Use Policy
acceptance_criteria: 19.3.1 On first login, new users shall be prompted the terms and conditions for the use of CRIPS. He/She must review all the terms and conditions before he/she can acknowledge that he/she agree to abide by them. Only upon acknowledging the AUP, he/she can access the CRIPS modules and functions available for him/her.

19.3.2 On an annual basis (to use 1st Jan of each year), all existing users shall be prompted to acknowledge the AUP again. Only upon acknowledging the AUP, he/she can access the CRIPS modules and functions available for him/her.

19.3.3 System shall allow changes to the terms and conditions listed in the AUP. The updates shall be implemented easily, e.g. updates by Administrator or Service Requests. 20. ACCOUNT REVIEWER USER STORY

title: Review Accounts
acceptance_criteria: 20.1.1 System shall generate a task at the start of each month and set the due date for completion to be end of the same month. System shall allow changes in review frequency so as to adhere to the latest policy, e.g. changing review frequency, e.g. from monthly to 3-monthly. System shall allow such changes to be implemented easily, e.g. via changes to site properties.
20.1.2 System shall generate an email to inform Account Reviewer of a task pending his/her action.

20.1.3 System shall categorise the user accounts into “Active Accounts”, “Suspended Accounts” and “Removed Accounts”. When reviewing, system shall display all accounts including the Reviewer’s account. Account Reviewer must not be allowed to review his/her own account. However, his/her account must still be reviewed, i.e. by another Account Reviewer. a. “Active Accounts” tab. Fields to be displayed shall include userID, full name, appointment, Unit/Department, Ministry/Agency, roles assigned, last login date. b. c. “Suspended Accounts” tab. Fields to be displayed shall include the userID, full name, appointment, Unit/Department, Ministry/Agency, roles assigned, last login date, account suspended date, remarks. Remarks should indicate why the account was suspended, e.g. due to inactivity for more than 90 days. “Removed Accounts” tab. Fields to be displayed shall include userID, full name, appointment, Unit/Department, Ministry/Agency, roles assigned, last login date, account removal date, remarks. Remarks should indicate why the account was deleted, e.g. due to inactivity for more than 180 days; change in unit.

20.1.4 Account Reviewer shall be able to click into the account and the system shall display the detailed information of the user (i.e. full name, appointment, department, email addresses, remarks, role assignment, ReqCen assignment, etc).

20.1.5 In each tab, by default, system shall list all accounts pending review, i.e. “Pending Verification” list. Upon Account Reviewer selection of the users by clicking on the respective checkbox, it shall allow Account Reviewer to choose "Verify" or "Remove" of the selected records. Upon choosing “Verify", the verified account shall be listed on "Verified" list. Upon choosing "Remove", the removed account shall be listed on "Removed" list. A "Select All" button shall be included in each page so that Account Reviewer can apply "Verify" or "Remove" to all the selected records.
20.1.6 Account Reviewer shall only be allowed to complete the task when all the accounts listed in the task are reviewed.

20.1.7 When the Account Review module is launched, system shall display a summary of all account review tasks and also shows basic information of each task, e.g. review status (e.g. open, completed), task start date, task due date, completed on, completed by. When reviewer clicks on each task, it should display information of all accounts included in the task.
20.1.8 Within each task, system shall provide an option for Account Reviewer to export all the records within the task.
20.1.9 The overall layout of the summary shall be similar to that for log review module.

title: Monthly User Account Review
acceptance_criteria: 20.2.1 System shall send user an email notification to inform users to review his/her account. The contents in the email shall state the deadline to complete the review, typically within 21 calendar days. The duration shall be easily configurable using site properties or other suitable means.

20.2.2 Informed users shall login to CRIPS to confirm if he/she still requires the user account in his/her current appointment. If he/she clicks ‘Yes’, the account shall be maintained as active. If he/she clicks ‘No’, system shall delete the account immediately.

20.2.3 System shall send a reminder via email notification to inform users to review his/her account if he/she has not done so after 14 calendar days. The duration shall be easily configurable using site properties or other suitable means. The contents in the email shall remind him/her of the required actions and also state the deadline to complete the review.

20.2.4 System shall suspend the user of his/her account if he/she does not do review his/her account by the stipulated deadline. He/She will receive an email to inform his/her has been suspended as the review was not done. Administrator shall be able to toggle the account from ‘Suspended’ to ‘Active’.

title: De-provision user accounts
acceptance_criteria: 20.3.1 For users who did not complete the required account review by the stipulated deadline, system shall suspend his/her account and send him/her an email notification to inform the account is suspended as review was not done. OFFICIAL (CLOSED) OFFICIAL (CLOSED)

20.3.2 For user who is a MINDEF/SAF personnel, system shall check the records in EIMS/EAD to verify his/her term of services or employment status. If he/she is no longer working in MINDEF/SAF, the user account shall be deleted automatically and immediately.
20.3.3 Upon expiry of CR requisition plans raised by ReqCens, system shall delete their EMA accounts automatically on the following day. 21. LOG REVIEWER USER STORY

title: Review Logs
acceptance_criteria: 21.1.1 System shall generate a task at the start of each week and set the due date for completion to be within 7 working days. System shall allow changes in review frequency or completion timeline so as to adhere to the latest policy, e.g. changing completion timeline, e.g. from 7 working days to 14 calendar days. System shall allow such changes to be implemented easily, e.g. via changes to site properties.
21.1.2 System shall generate an email to inform Log Reviewer of a task pending his/her action.

21.1.3 System shall categorise the logs into “Compensation Rates”, “User Accounts”, “Failed Login” and “Failed Validation”. When reviewing, system shall display all logs including the Reviewer’s logs. Log Reviewer must not be allowed to review his/her own logs. However, his/her logs must still be reviewed, i.e. by another Log Reviewer. a. 21.1.4 “Compensation Rates” tab. Fields to be displayed shall include CR Category, CR Type, rate type (e.g. hourly with undertakings), old value, new value, modified by, modified on (date and time). b. “User Accounts” tab. Fields to be displayed shall include the userID, full name, Ministry/Agency/Unit, role, action (add/remove), modified by, modified on (date and time). c. “Failed Login” tab. Fields to be displayed shall include userID, full name, appointment, Ministry/Agency/Unit, message, log created on (date and time). Message shall indicate why the log was recorded, e.g. invalid user. d. “Failed Validation” tab. Fields to be displayed shall include userID, full name, Unit/Department, Ministry/Agency, screen, message, modified on (date and time). Screen field shall indicate where the validation failed, e.g. Service Acceptance Details. Message field shall indicate what is the failed validation, e.g. accepted quantity cannot exceed the available limit. In each tab, by default, system shall list all logs pending review, i.e. “Pending Verification” list. Upon Log Reviewer selection of the logs by clicking on the respective checkbox, it shall allow Log Reviewer to choose "Verify" of the selected records. Upon choosing “Verify", the verified logs shall be listed on "Verified" list. OFFICIAL (CLOSED) OFFICIAL (CLOSED)
21.1.5 A "Select All" button shall be included in each page so that Log Reviewer can apply "Verify" to all the selected records.
21.1.6 Log Reviewer shall only be allowed to complete the task when all the logs listed in the task are reviewed.

21.1.7 When the Log Review module is launched, system shall display a summary of all log review tasks and also show basic information of each task, e.g. review status (e.g. open, completed), task start date, task due date, completed on, completed by.
21.1.8 When reviewer clicks on each task, it should display information of all logs included in the task.

title: Learning and Sharing
acceptance_criteria: 22.1.1 Chief Controller Office, Controllers, CROs and Administrators shall be allowed to upload files. After he/she has attached the file and upon clicking on the ‘Save’ button, system shall require him/her to acknowledge: a. The document classification is ‘Restricted’ or below.
22.1.2 b. He/She has scanned the file(s) and it does not contain any malware.
22.1.3 Chief Controller Office, Controllers, CROs and Administrators shall be allowed to housekeep the documents (e.g. delete outdated materials) in the Learning and Sharing module.
22.1.4 System shall show the date/time the documents are published in the Learning and Sharing module.
22.1.5 Users shall be able to download the documents available in the Learning and Sharing module.
22.1.6 Users shall be able to search using keywords. The search shall also be able to search keywords within documents available in the Learning and Sharing module.
